doctrine: The visual artifact represents proof-backed state; it is not proof itself.
event_taxonomy_policy: Each visual event type maps to allowed truth states.
Unknown or contradictory states fail closed.
forbidden_claim_policy: Never show sent, submitted, paid, complete, or approved unless proof allows it.
Visual prompts must explicitly block false success claims.
Video or animation output is never proof.
mac_render_policy: Mac may render the package later using local UI assets.
This compiler does not play media or write Swift.
Target surface is compact Mac chat by default.
compiler.next_safe_move: Use these packages as local visual render inputs only after Mac chooses a safe renderer.
privacy_policy: Raw client data, PO numbers, emails, file paths, hashes, credentials, legal/tax data, and database schemas are blocked.
provider_policy: Interactive chat status defaults to native Mac animation or static visual cards.
Cloud generation is blocked for client-private and protected contexts.
Provider candidates are future gated capabilities, not execution authority.
source_truth_policy: Visual event packages derive from response/readback/proof refs.
Package readiness, dry-run status, and completion status remain separate truth states.
No package may claim success without receipt-backed completion.
visual_metaphor_policy: Metaphors must not contradict the source truth state.
Bowling-style feedback is allowed only as a status metaphor.
A strike or perfect sweep requires completion receipts.
